title: 第3章 我儿莫慌为父给你出头第4章 爹退婚吧我配不上
content_zh:
“爹！”
许小凡见自家父亲来了，却没有半分喜色。
反而眼角有些湿润，心中愧疚万分。
他自己非但没苟住，反而还连累了父亲！
父亲此来，恐怕要受辱！
“这么大的人了，还哭哭啼啼的，像什么样子！”
许渊淡淡瞥了一眼儿子。
眼底却不易察觉的带着一抹赞许之色。
好大儿，爹没看错你啊！
下一刻几行文字，浮现在许渊面前。
【检查到二人修为与宿主修为对比处于弱小方，随机特殊任务触发】
【许风与大长老对您儿子起了杀心，击杀二人可获得青玄剑（等阶未知）】
见状，许渊心中大喜！
欣喜之余，他表情淡漠扭头看向大长老以及许风。
“我儿少了一根头发，这件事怎么算？”
闻言，在场众人一脸惊愕！
这不分青红皂白的本事，大长老都得向你看齐！
“你说什么！”
“你儿子废了我儿子，你现在还来质问老子？”
许风怒急攻心之下，不管不顾一拳轰出！

先天境修为爆发之下，单是拳风便吹的人脸皮疼痛！
这一拳并不是杀招，而是朝着肩膀轰去！
很明显，许风并不想许渊就这么死了！
他要将对方擒下，然后慢慢折磨！
然而，就在许小凡再次准备使用传送符，带着父亲一起跑路的时候。
只见许渊抬手，伸出一根手指，结结实实挡下了这一拳！
全场众人都有些懵，但更懵的还在后边！
就见许渊手指微微一弹！
下一刻，许风的整条手臂顿时炸成一团血雾！
漫天血雾飘散间。
许渊的身影出现在许风面前。
一只手掐住对方脖子，并且将其凌空提了起来！
全程，许风毫无反抗之力！
寂静，死一般的寂静！
众人一脸不可置信的看着这一幕！
闹呢这是？说好的修为尽废呢！
“你...你恢复修为了？！”
许风低头，看了一眼空空荡荡的右臂，随后目眦欲裂的看向许渊！
想要接着说话，可那股窒息感却越来越强烈。
content_en:
"Dad!"
Xu Xiaofan didn't look happy when he saw his father coming.
Instead, the corners of his eyes were moist, and he felt extremely guilty.
Not only did he not stand still, but he even got his father into trouble!
My father may be humiliated when he comes here!
"What does it look like for such a big man to still cry and cry!"
Xu Yuan glanced at his son lightly.
There was a hint of approval in his eyes that was not easily noticeable.
What a big boy, daddy saw you right!
The next moment, a few lines of text appeared in front of Xu Yuan.
[It was found that the cultivation base of the two was on the weaker side compared to the cultivation base of the host, and a random special mission was triggered]
[Xu Feng and the great elder have murderous intentions towards your son. If you kill them, you will get the Qingxuan Sword (unknown level)]
Seeing this, Xu Yuan was overjoyed!
Overjoyed, he turned to look at the Great Elder and Xu Feng with an indifferent expression.
"My son is missing a hair, how can this be counted?"
Hearing this, everyone present was shocked!
With this indiscriminate ability, even the great elders must emulate you!
"What did you say!"
"Your son crippled my son, and now you're here to question me?"
Xu Feng was so angry that he punched out without hesitation!
When Xiantian realm cultivation explodes, just the wind from the fist will make one's face hurt!
This punch was not a killing move, but a blow to the shoulder!
Obviously, Xu Feng didn't want Xu Yuan to die like this!
He wants to capture the opponent and then slowly torture him!
However, just when Xu Xiaofan was about to use the teleportation talisman again and run away with his father.
Xu Yuan raised his hand, stretched out a finger, and blocked the punch firmly!
Everyone in the audience was a little confused, but the ones who were even more confused were still behind!
Xu Yuan flicked his fingers slightly!
The next moment, Xu Feng's entire arm suddenly exploded into a ball of blood mist!
The blood mist spread all over the sky.
Xu Yuan's figure appeared in front of Xu Feng.
He grabbed the opponent's neck with one hand and lifted him up into the air!
Throughout the whole process, Xu Feng had no power to resist!
Silence, deathly silence!
Everyone looked at this scene with disbelief!
What's going on? The promised cultivation is completely ruined!
"You...you restored your cultivation?!"
Xu Feng lowered his head, glanced at his empty right arm, and then looked at Xu Yuan with splitting eyes!
I wanted to continue talking, but the feeling of suffocation was getting stronger and stronger.
